# Incident freeze policy

During an incident, freeze everything unrelated. A freeze means no deploys, no config edits, no dependency bumps. Lift the freeze only when the incident is closed. Write down who declared the freeze and who lifted it; a freeze without an owner never ends. Compare [[release-freeze-windows]].
